verdict.rationale: Galileo explicitly supports building datasets from live production data alongside synthetic/dev data (galileo-docs-11), managing datasets via console/MCP (galileo-docs-4, galileo-docs-32), and running offline 'Experiments' that evaluate prompts/models against chosen metrics (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-3), directly matching the curate-from-production-traces + offline-eval story. Production trace/session capture is well documented (galileo-docs-6, galileo-docs-7) providing the source data for curation. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end walkthrough showing traces being converted into a dataset and then run through an experiment, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
